text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Reality is full of all sorts of "lip 
service."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"You, and you, and even you are the 
protagonist." ...As if to say, there are 
no side characters.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
However, the protagonist of a manga is 
decided the moment they appear.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa~ So this rival was fighting to carry 
on his older brother's will... *sniff*... 
Man, this really brings tears to my eyes~"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: “—Now, what will our protagonist do?!”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...No matter how much supporting 
characters add color to a story, it's the 
'protagonist' who stands at its center.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist is the one who makes the 
story exciting. The protagonist is the one 
who drives the story forward.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—I want to surpass Almond Eye! I want to 
win! I want to rewrite history!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even if you are a protagonist so dazzling 
it blinds! I will create an even greater 
thrill with these legs of mine!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: This is—our 'story'!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ――...Because it's a "story"...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Aaaalmond Eye!! Here comes Almond 
Eye!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (I don't want to lose...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"So strong! What a Classic-class 
Umamusume! A true Triple Tiara champion!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (I don't want to give it up...!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (As the protagonist, to you, I—...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Right now! Right this moment! History is 
being rewritten—!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What a legendary clash...! What a 
finish...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Right now, we have witnessed the birth of 
a legend! We have become witnesses to 
history!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...âWhyâ...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I promised everyone I'd show them the 
strongest... Today, if only for today—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —I didn't want to lose...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Almond Eyeeee!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Isn't Ai-chan just so cool after all!? I 
totally love the way Ai-chan runs~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
...Almond Eye, keep pushing forward just 
like this. You're the Umamusume who will 
change the world...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: …………Aaaah...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: …………Aaaaargh――...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You have it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, on the final stretch, I 
felt like my legs were going to tear right 
off. My whole body was burning up..."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happened, I just wanted to 
win so badly! So I kept pushing my legs 
forward. Straight toward the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
――The heart necessary for a protagonist, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Back in the Junior Class, I was so 
inspired by Kiseki-chan's and the other 
Umamusume's races. I dreamed of running 
alongside them.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Even knowing they're still completely out 
of reach, I just can't give up reaching 
out my hand.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even the hurdles I stumbled on... —you 
cleared them with ease.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No matter what kind of Umamusume is ahead 
of me, I want to win!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Because this desire to win will carry on! 
Endlessly! No matter how far!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Everything was perfect. It was 
flawless.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: She was a born protagonist...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I go to meet Kiseki as she returns from 
finishing the race, looking as though she 
were fleeing the cheers.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaaahhhh――...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Kiseki lost.
